questions.q: What new abilities did early humans develop to survive changing environments?
questions.why: Early humans needed walking and throwing to adapt to less food and more predators.

questions.q: Why does the author say community was crucial for early human survival?
a: It made hunting and defense easier
questions.why: With more people working together, predators could be turned into food.

questions.q: What does the book suggest about lottery winners' long‑term happiness?
questions.why: Lottery winners have a short boost but later return to previous happiness levels.

questions.q: According to the book, what drives human happiness evolutionarily?
questions.why: Humans are happiest when doing things that promote longevity and passing on genes.

questions.q: Which lesson explains why humans find it hard to choose fulfilling activities?
questions.why: Humans have many choices, most of which do not give true fulfillment.
